newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany's DAX index ends bourse down 2.1 percent.
newsitem.headline: Germany's DAX index ends bourse down 2.1 percent.

text.p: 1245 GMT - German shares end bourse trade sharply lower as DAX index tumbles 2.1 percent. Dealers cite wave of profit taking triggered by Friday's Wall Street losses and dollar briefly dipping below 1.79 marks as factors. Merger between Bayerische Hypo and Vereinsbank fails to help much. Bourse extended for an hour due to technical troubles that earlier interrupted bourse and IBIS computer trade.
* DAX ends bourse down 88.13 points at 4,108.40 points. IBIS DAX down 26.20 points at 4,105.74 points.
* Vereinsbank and Hypo lead percentage gainers on merger news, which will create second-largest bank in Germany.
